value.rationale: The family \(p^2qr\) is the first nonsquarefree three-prime multiplicity pattern. A complete unbounded classification of its even harmonic stratum is a natural structural extension beyond the classical two-prime-support theory and explains the isolated role of \(140\) in the first boundary layer.
